verdict.rationale: Requesty's docs include a dedicated Bring Your Own Keys feature page stating you can use your personal API keys from various providers with Requesty, which directly matches the story. The evidence is a single first-party sentence with no further detail. Missing for 10: setup and configuration details, the list of supported providers, how BYOK traffic is billed versus the 5% markup, how BYOK interacts with routing and fallback, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
